extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed final mechanism ontology; direct claims are limited to assays performed in the paper and inferred ferrocene context is not promoted to direct mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Fc-RP1 increases carboxyfluorescein release from POPC and POPC:POPS vesicles relative to RP1 under tested conditions, supporting membrane permeabilization/pore-formation activity in a model membrane assay.
direct_assay_types: carboxyfluorescein release from large unilamellar vesicles

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=Evaluation of the peptide’s capacity to permeabilize vesicles; xml:fig=8

mechanism_claims.limitations: Model-vesicle permeabilization is direct biophysical evidence, not direct pathogen-cell pore visualization.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Circular dichroism experiments show RP1/Fc-RP1 structural changes in membrane-mimetic environments, providing supporting context for membrane interaction.
mechanism_claims.limitations: CD spectra support membrane interaction context but are not by themselves antimicrobial mechanism proof.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper discusses ferrocene-associated membrane destabilization/lipid peroxidation and ROS as a plausible contributor to Fc-RP1 activity.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is a mechanistic hypothesis/context from discussion and cited literature, not a direct ROS assay in this paper.

mechanism_quality_control.overclaim_guard: Only the vesicle CF-release claim is direct_mechanism; CD and ferrocene redox context remain supporting/inferred.
